props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability establishing institutional trust in user-operated endpoint devices.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint and user-operated compute technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: User-operated endpoint devices, operating systems, and execution environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern

props.name: data-entity

metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Core defines the foundational capability that establishes whether a device is recognized as an institutional endpoint. It defines enrollment requirements, classification boundaries, execution environment legitimacy, and baseline trust assumptions independently of configuration hardening, health evaluation, or threat detection.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint identity, recognition, and baseline trust. Advanced controls (hardening, health, detection) are composed separately to preserve clean security semantics.

components.title: Endpoint Enrollment
components.description: Formal enrollment and registration of devices into institutional endpoint management and trust systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of unmanaged or fraudulently registered devices using valid credentials.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal device registration and lifecycle governance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Establish and manage unique identities for endpoint devices.

components.title: Endpoint Classification
components.description: Classification of endpoints by ownership, role, and permitted institutional usage.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading of untrusted or non-compliant devices as legitimate endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit classification and policy binding based on endpoint type.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and enforce policies governing endpoint use and classification.

components.title: Execution Boundaries
components.description: Definition of trust and execution boundaries between endpoint environments and institutional services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of user-controlled code crossing assumed trust boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit enforcement of execution and trust boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and enforce boundaries between endpoint execution environments and institutional systems.

components.title: Baseline Trust
components.description: Establishment of minimum trust assumptions required for endpoint participation in institutional services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of externally facing services via untrusted endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Require explicit baseline trust before endpoint participation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Allow only approved endpoint services and execution behaviors.
